# Zork I, II and III

The story files of Infocom's Zork I (release 119, serial 880429), Zork
II (release 63, 860811) and Zork III (release 25, 860811), as compiled
for the Z-machine (version 3), unchanged. They come from the
`COMPILED` directories of the repositories that Microsoft published
under the MIT licence on 2025-11-20:

- https://github.com/historicalsource/zork1
- https://github.com/historicalsource/zork2
- https://github.com/historicalsource/zork3

`LICENSE` is their licence (MIT, copyright 2025 Microsoft), the same in
the three. The games' names are trademarks; the licence covers the code
and the files, not the names.

MyNOS plays them with its own interpreter, the package `zmachine`
(`packages/zmachine`); each story is a package of data that needs it
(`packages/zork1`...).
